name: x402-guard-showcase
description: Three acts on Base USDC and Solana USDC, on three seats: twzrd.safeFetch, createGuardedX402Fetch on an @x402/fetch client, and createGuardedX402SolanaFetch on the stock x402-solana client, each with typed events: allow with a verified V7 receipt, block before the signer, and a .kill halt. JSON trace, one act at a time, or step through. Loopback seller and Solana RPC stub, demo signers, no keys, no spend.
